en.description:
The right direction is only half the puzzle. The fridge needs to stop in the right place, too.

Fridge Slide is an ice-sliding logic puzzle designed for Apple Watch. Move your character around the board and push each fridge onto a snowflake target. The twist is in the swipe: the same direction can produce a very different landing spot depending on how you swipe.

CONTROL THE DISTANCE

Use light, medium or strong swipes to send a fridge up to 1, 3 or 5 tiles across the ice. A wall or another fridge stops it early.

Targets do not stop a moving fridge. Make a gentle push near a target, or use a stronger swipe to cross open space. The challenge is to land exactly where you planned.

TURN OBSTACLES INTO OPPORTUNITIES

Walls can block your route, but they can also help you stop exactly where you need to.

With multiple fridges on the board, the order of your pushes matters. Think about where to stand, which path to leave open and how your next move will affect the rest of the puzzle. You can push a fridge, but you cannot pull it back.

EXPLORE 15 LEVELS

Work through single-fridge puzzles, narrow passages, turns and multi-target layouts.

Place every fridge on a target to unlock the next level. Return to unlocked levels and look for a route that takes fewer moves.

UNDO, RETHINK, TRY AGAIN

Undo recent moves or restart the current level when a plan goes off course. Change your position, adjust your swipe and test a different route.

See your move count after each completed puzzle, then challenge yourself to find a smarter solution.

A SMALL SCREEN, A SATISFYING CHALLENGE

Play directly on Apple Watch with swipe controls and optional haptic feedback. Core puzzle gameplay works offline.

Unlocked levels and your selected level are stored locally on the watch. Open a puzzle during a short break and give yourself something different to think about.

DEVICE REQUIREMENT

Gameplay is available only on Apple Watch. The iPhone and iPad versions provide watch installation and usage guidance; they do not include playable phone or tablet versions.

zh.description:
方向对了，还要停得刚刚好。

推冰箱是一款专为 Apple Watch 设计的冰面推箱解谜游戏。在小小的棋盘上，你需要移动角色，把冰箱推向雪花标记的位置。但冰面让每一次推动都多了一层变化：同一个方向，不同的滑动力度，可能带来完全不同的落点。

【推的不只是方向，还有距离】

通过滑动控制角色移动，并在接触冰箱时将它推出。轻、中、重三档力度分别让冰箱最多滑行 1、3、5 格；遇到墙壁或其他冰箱时，它会提前停下。

雪花目标不会让滑行中的冰箱自动停住。靠近目标时轻轻一推，穿过空旷冰面时增加力度，让冰箱落在你计划的位置，而不是从目标上滑过去。

【障碍，也可以是停靠点】

墙壁不只是阻挡路线，还能帮助你控制冰箱的落点。

多台冰箱同时出现时，先推哪一台、从哪一侧绕过去、为下一步留下多少空间，都需要提前考虑。冰箱只能推，不能拉，眼前的一步也可能改变后面的整条路线。

【15 关，逐步解开冰面谜题】

从单台冰箱的入门挑战，到多目标、窄道和转弯布局，15 个关卡带来不同的路线选择。

将所有冰箱送到目标位置，即可解锁下一关。你也可以重新选择已解锁关卡，尝试用更少的步数完成，让熟悉的棋盘产生新的解法。

【推错了，就退一步再想】

支持撤销最近的移动和重新开始关卡。不必因为一次失误放弃思路：调整站位、改变力度，再试另一条路线。

通关后查看本次步数，感受从“终于归位”到“这一步更巧”的变化。

【小屏幕上的一场专注挑战】

直接在 Apple Watch 上滑动操作，核心解谜玩法可离线进行。已解锁关卡与所选关卡保存在本机，触感反馈可在设置中关闭。

等候时、休息时，打开手表思考几步，用一场冰面谜题换换思路。

设备说明：
游戏玩法仅在 Apple Watch 上提供。iPhone 和 iPad 版本用于显示手表使用与安装引导，不提供手机或平板上的游戏玩法。
